message: test(items): isolate bulk-stack fixtures and exercise native quantity editing
purpose: The new commerce fixture incorrectly searched the production catalog for a 150-stack item although current stack limits are 99. Keep all large-stack, exact-price, replay and conservation assertions. Use a copied test-only catalog with a 999-cap copper-ore definition for bulk cases; do not change production catalog capacities. Enter quantities through native key events instead of expecting programmatic LineEdit.Text to emit a user-edit signal. Distinguish base armor from bonus armor in the compact stat labels. Retain every existing backend and graphical check.
